caption_L1: Average costs of remodeling projects in the United States in 2013 (in U.S. dollars) is a bar diagram. The x-axis shows Project. There is a linear scale of range 0 to 200,000 along the y-axis, marked Average cost in U.S. dollars.
caption_L2L3: Upscaling a master suite was, on average, the most expensive remodelling project in the US in 2013, costing over 200,000 US dollars. Remodelling a backup power generator was, on average, the cheapest project costing under 50,000 US dollars. A two story addition was the second most expensive project on average, with a cost of just over 150,000 US dollars.
